GroupMe authorization

Checking authorization…

In Cloudflare → Workers & Pages → chatgpt → Settings → Variables and Secrets, add or replace the Secret named GROUPME_ACCESS_TOKEN. Copy the token below, paste it into that secret, and deploy the settings.

The token is kept only in this page’s memory. Do not paste it into chat. Close this tab after configuring Cloudflare.

Open GroupMe →

Run GroupMe →

If you already added GROUPME_ACCESS_TOKEN in Cloudflare, open Run GroupMe. No authorization callback is needed.
